While the gunplay is fun and the combat weakspots alongside the dark souls' formula baked into the game makes it fun, it stops there.
The characters are 2 dimensional to the point they feel insulting and more like an embodied stereotype than anything, the lore and characters interactions are extremely pretentious with its delivery while failing miserably to achieve the depth, complexity or honesty it claims over and over at every step.
The mechanics for meta progression are intentionally convoluted and hidden, some classes are gated behind data that had to be datamined as an intentional step, which while interesting as first, fails to deliver later as it was simply left as is, the same fault extending to puzzle with "secret" codes making you lose out on a weapon if you are not googling every step.
Bugs are still present and fairly common, specially in co-op.
Not worth the regular price tag of 70€ with the DLCs.
Maybe 15€.

Really great shooter with fun boss fights and dungeons and they're much better, bigger and challenging compared to Remnant 1!

Getting new gear feels rewarding and there's tons of different builds that you can go for. Remnant 2 really expanded with different builds + items that you can use for very quirky builds. Playing solo or with friends works amazingly well and you can enable your game so random players can join to your current story progression or you can join others. 

I've also played Remnant 1 and which is better is personal opinion imo, both are great Remnant 2 being more complex.

One bad thing is that the randomized maps and layouts and the whole dungeon system is quite confusing before you understand how it works and how to progress in linear sense. Also this game got like 500 rings to wear with different stats and bonuses, hard to keep track of everything. 

9/10, we need more PVE MP/COOP games!

Pretty enjoyable and worth playing, but with some noticeable flaws. 

Way too many secrets. You constantly run into puzzles that are not reasonably solvable without looking them up on the wiki. This results in you standing around a lot. Kills the pacing in co-op. I understand if a game is hard to 100%, but this game would be hard to even 50%.

In co-op, if you die and are not revived in time, you're stuck waiting for several minutes until your group reaches the next checkpoint.

Progression is slow and weird. Even after multiple playthroughs, I'm always starving for money. Enemies scale partially based on your weapons, so you're better off not upgrading them. Fortunately that makes it easier to have fun trying out different weapons. Build variety is pretty good, it just takes a very long time to get going.
Cool game for co-op. Fun combat, great visuals, good replayability and story is mid but alright.
